identity.alias_note: Four CSV spellings verified as the same humans as canonical chart names (2026-09-19 investigation, re-confirmed vs Supabase players.full_name).

inputs.games_divisor: per team: games inside ros_weeks (bye excluded)
inputs.pies_method: pie = sum(max(0, per-game - waiver_pg)); waiver = next-unrostered per-game; rostered = teams*slots + flex (teams flex from RB/WR/TE pool after dedicated) + bench_mix scaled by teams/12 (round-half-up). Skill pg = ROS components rescored per scoring / 16 (weeks 3-18). K pg = mean weekly appliedTotal w3-18 (bye 0 included). DST pg = mean w3-18 of 9/19 component recipe (bye included). Skill pies recomputed 2026-09-22 with workbook-aligned bench_mix (QB10/TE10), calibrate=False pool measurement.
inputs.rescoring_note: per-game = ROS components rescored per scoring / the team's games inside ESPN's ROS window (bye excluded). Reception points are the only scoring difference: ppr = half_ppr + 0.5*receptions, standard = half_ppr - 0.5*receptions. Arithmetic on ESPN components only; no expert blending.

calibration_notes: QB: bench share 0.15 below the feasible window; using 0.199 (0.0100 inside its lower edge 0.1887)
